_instructions._meaning: This is a ground-truth authoring template, not part of the real CallAnalysis schema — this whole key is ignored by sawti.data.ground_truth.load_ground_truth(). Delete it or leave it; either is fine once the file is filled in.
_instructions.call_id: Do not edit — identifies the transcript this reviews (data/synthetic/<call_id>.txt).
_instructions.language: Do not edit — inferred from the transcript filename's _ar/_en/_mixed suffix.
_instructions.summary: Fill in: a short human-written summary of the call. Required, non-empty.
_instructions.commitments: Open-ended list — append one entry per promise/commitment you find in the call (evidence, promised_by, description, deadline). Leave as [] if there are none.
_instructions.compliance_flags: Open-ended list — append one entry per compliance violation you find in the call (evidence, rule_id, severity, description). Leave as [] if there are none.
_instructions.rubric_scores: Fill in every one of the 7 entries below (do not add, remove, or rename criteria) — set 'score' (0.0-1.0), 'justification', and a grounding 'evidence' quote for each.
_instructions.evidence: A verbatim quote grounding the claim/score: {text, speaker, start_char, end_char}. Use `uv run python scripts/find_quote.py <transcript> "<exact substring>"` to get exact offsets — do not hand-count them.
_instructions.sentiment_trajectory: Optional — append chronologically ordered {quote, speaker, score, timestamp_sec} points if you want to track sentiment across the call. Leave 'points' as [] if skipping.
_instructions.confidence: Fill in: your overall confidence in this review, 0.0-1.0. Required.
_instructions.requires_human_review: Fill in: true or false. Must be true if confidence is below the configured threshold (sawti.config.Settings.confidence_threshold).
